idle.ipe.rest is operated by Davy Kim (ipe Studio). This page explains what information this site handles and how. It covers this site only; the full policy for ipe.rest is linked at the end.

1. Information we handle

  • No accounts. This site does not ask for an account, your name, a phone number or a password.
  • Visit statistics. We use Google Analytics 4 to count page views. It sets cookies such as _ga for this purpose. We also use Cloudflare Web Analytics, which records aggregate page views and load performance and sets no cookies.
  • Email. If you write to us, we receive your email address and what you write, and we use them to reply to you and handle your request.

2. Advertising

This site may show advertisements served by Google AdSense. Google and other third-party vendors use cookies, including DoubleClick cookies, to serve ads based on your prior visits to this site or to other sites. You may turn off personalized advertising in Google Ads Settings. You can also opt out of third-party cookies used for personalized advertising at www.aboutads.info. To learn how Google uses advertising cookies, see policies.google.com/technologies/ads.

3. Cookies and your choices

You can refuse or delete cookies at any time in your browser settings. Most browsers let you block all cookies or only third-party cookies. The site remains readable if you do.

4. We do not sell personal information

We do not sell personal information.

5. Contact

For questions about this policy, email ipe.haven@gmail.com or see the contact page.

6. Changes

We may update this policy. We will post changes on this page and update the effective date at the top.

Effective date

This policy takes effect on 2026-11-16.

Full policy

The full ipe.rest privacy policy, which covers all ipe() websites and apps, is at https://ipe.rest/en/legal/privacy/.
